# WorkStream checker fixture

This fixture retains the WorkStream checker at revision `a2154e8a4efec5712d69b96834f0ffc707ef54f1`.
The source is `external_checkers/harnessy_proof/checker.py` in `Flow-Research/workstream`.
Its SHA-256 digest is `29e6a031addae960545108fd81d41fa7053f8a10a22822693f2134b38f931c9e`.

The checker is unchanged. The adjacent `LICENSE` retains its GNU AGPL v3 license.
The source URL is https://github.com/Flow-Research/workstream/blob/a2154e8a4efec5712d69b96834f0ffc707ef54f1/external_checkers/harnessy_proof/checker.py.

`evaluate.py` supplies synthetic facts to the real checker through its public function.
These tests establish proof compatibility. They do not establish live WorkStream acceptance or deployed checker identity.
